description: Station Vélo en Libre Service VLS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Saint-Denis. Location of Vélo en Libre Service (VLS) stations in Saint-Denis. Coverage: Mairie de Saint-Denis. The portal shows the English title as "VLS Free Service Bike Station" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Saint-Denis. Its keywords include territoire, equipements-publics, equipement-public, sports-loisirs, mobilite, equipements-sportifs. The listing shows 6 download or service links in TXT, ZIP, KML, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2023-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
